The rights of ownership of the content's author must be preserved (i.e., hidden, but not erased. Author must be able to retrieve content within reasonable period) and author's profits generated per view must be paid. Social Media must not harm right to profit from creators' work.

The other side of the coin is the century old laws regulating private telephone exchanges.
